Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Production latency + errors from today (reserved capacity)

Quick update from infra triage (10:00 PDT):
- Root signal: sustained queue growth on BlueHarbor's reserved GPU pool (pool: us-west-2-dedicated-12). Token processing per-second for that reservation dropped ~42% — consistent with the customer report.
- Observed correlated CPU steal on the host hypervisor layer for 3 nodes in the pool (node ids: gpool-usw2-12-n03, -n04, -n07). We are investigating whether a noisy neighbor or driver regression caused the slowdown.
- Fallback rules: the automated fallback to compatible quantized model variant did not trigger because request metadata surfaced an exact model pin (customer pinned a variant) — fallback is therefore blocked by config.

Immediate mitigations we can enact (order of operations):
1) Isolate affected nodes and drain to standby to stop error amplification (ETA 20m).
2) Temporarily re-route new requests from the reservation to compatible dedicated pool spare capacity in us-west-2 (we have short-term spare capacity but it increases token cost) (ETA 15m to raft changes).
3) For long-tail safety, enable a conservative request-level throttle to limit burst concurrency for the reservation (ETA 10m).

Karthik
(Snippet forwarded)
